scope: D02 automated diagnostic failure and privacy boundaries; test-only changes

scenarios.evidence: Project manifest exceeds 4,000,000 bytes after large private names and 10,000 MIDI notes; diagnostic bytes remain identical to small baseline and below 4096 bytes.

Atomic JSON export targeting existing directory fails; sentinel bytes and directory entries preserved; project, dirty flag, Undo count, projectURL preserved. Retrying sibling JSON path yields parseable allowlisted JSON below 4096 bytes.
Immediate cancellation before MainActor publication, followed by reader drain, leaves no output and preserves project/dirty; next export succeeds.
User edit with unchanged project ID before publication rejects old snapshot; no output; new project and Undo count retained.
Large private activity source/message and agent job ID/message/path do not appear in exported bytes; only typed save/failed runtime state remains; JSON below 4096 bytes.

notVerified: Actual NSSavePanel interaction or destination failure UI
Physical disk full or permission revocation
Cancellation during live large-media hash scan through native UI
validationBoundary: Real filesystem writes and actual ProjectMediaWorkspace APIs in XCTest; not a claim of native UI acceptance.
